_comment: Edge case: /query request with a missing required payload field. SchemaValidator raises a validation error and the API returns HTTP 400 before reaching the orchestrator.

errors: Request validation failed: payload must satisfy at least one of: matchCriteriaId, cpeName, cpe, cveId

notes: Schema validation uses docs/04-graph/schemas/request-schema.json. For vuln_lookup, payload must contain at least one of: matchCriteriaId, cpeName, cpe (legacy alias), or cveId. An empty payload object fails the anyOf constraint.
